weather_selection.selection_rule: Contiguous three-month windows with >=20 non-holiday heavy-rain hours; maximize distinct wet events, then hours; no trip outcomes used
weather_selection.event_definition: Contiguous hours with rain>0 or snowfall>0; heavy hours may belong to the same wet event
weather_selection.season_limit: Summer estimates are not directly transferred to February planning

baseline: Dry non-holiday hours within the same year/month/weekday/hour; median trips and hourly median waits
interpretation: Descriptive associations, not causal effects; summer factors not transferred directly to February forecasts
